PlantOnboarding.description: Enter your site and equipment details. An administrator connects the data source and approves collection.
PlantOnboarding.locationHelp: Use the plant's coordinates and local timezone for daily forecasts.
PlantOnboarding.approvalNotice: Your plant will wait for administrator approval. Approval and forecast availability are shown separately.

PlantConfiguration.azimuthMustBeLessThan360Degrees: Azimuth must be less than 360 degrees.
PlantConfiguration.capacityGuide: DC nameplate is the panel rating. Inverter AC capacity is the inverter rating; grid export limit is the permitted grid cap. The measurement point identifies AC generation or net export.
PlantConfiguration.geometryGuide: For fixed mounting, tilt is 0–90 degrees; azimuth is clockwise from true north, from 0 up to but excluding 360 degrees. Tracking details are not captured. The current estimate uses a proxy that does not use these geometry fields.

PlantWorkspace.approvalStatus: Plant status: {status}. Contact Pyracast support at {contact} to resume collection.
PlantWorkspace.rejectedNotice: Pyracast support did not approve this plant.
PlantWorkspace.resubmitHelp: Correct the technical details or the location in the settings, then resubmit the plant for review.
PlantWorkspace.resubmitted: The plant is back in review.
PlantWorkspace.awaitingApproval: Awaiting administrator approval. Your plant details are saved; forecasts become available after the data connection is approved and collection succeeds.
PlantWorkspace.selectDateInRange: Choose a local day from {min} to {max} for this data source.
PlantWorkspace.approvalDetailsRequired: Complete technical details to request approval.
PlantWorkspace.deletionHelp: Move this plant, its location and associated history to the recycle bin for 30 days.
PlantWorkspace.calibrationUnavailable: Calibration becomes available after administrator approval and matched production history.
PlantWorkspace.plantTime: Times on this plant are in plant time: {zone}.

RegionSettings.approvalHelp: A location change requires administrator approval and a new connection verification.
RegionSettings.latestApproved: Location change approved on {date}. Forecasts pause until the new connection is approved.

Reminders.enableForecastEmailsForThisPlant: Enable forecast emails for this plant
Reminders.recipientLimitExceeded: Sending is paused above {limit, number} recipients. Remove addresses or turn off workspace members.
Reminders.recipientLimit: Use at most {limit, plural, one {# email address} other {# email addresses}}.
Reminders.reminderPolicy: Emails use the latest saved forecast and show its collection time and age; they do not request new provider data. Daylight-saving gaps are skipped and repeated local times run once. Daily limit: {limit}.
Reminders.approvalRequired: Reminders can be enabled once this plant is approved.
Reminders.membershipSync: Active, verified members are added and removed automatically.
Reminders.groupPrivacy: One email per send time. Recipients cannot see each other (BCC).
Reminders.recipientCountOnly: {count, plural, one {# recipient} other {# recipients}} of at most {limit, number}. Only the workspace administrator sees the addresses.
Reminders.noEmailYet: No email has been scheduled yet.

Outages.configurationRequired: Outages can be reported once the plant configuration is approved.
Outages.proposalUnavailable: Outages cannot be submitted right now.

proposalReasons.configuration_unavailable: Outages can be reported once the plant configuration is approved.
proposalReasons.pending_request_limit: Too many of your requests for this plant await approval. Withdraw one or wait for a decision before proposing another outage or a change to one.

Outages.capacityRequired: Enter at least one available capacity, or choose unknown impact.
Outages.capacityCeiling: At most {value} MW, the configured capacity.
Outages.invalidTime: Choose a valid time that is not in the future.
Outages.nonexistentTime: This time does not exist in the plant's time zone. Choose another time.
Outages.reportingHelp: Keep simultaneous faults in one incident and enter the total remaining plant capacity. Unknown impact stays unknown; it is never treated as zero.
Outages.editingHelp: Edit corrects an existing report. If available capacity changes during an outage, close this period and report the new operating state.
Outages.configurationChanged: Configuration changed. Edit this report to confirm remaining capacities. Outage impact is unknown until confirmed.
Outages.resolutionAfterStart: Resolution must be after the outage start.
Outages.confirmationIncorrect: I confirm this incident was recorded incorrectly.
Outages.remainingCapacityHelp: Enter remaining MW. Blank means unknown.
Outages.capacityHelp: Enter available capacity, not lost capacity. Disconnected panels reduce DC capacity. Do not infer a loss percentage from an inverter fault.
Outages.staleEdit: Someone changed this outage after you opened it. Your entries are kept.
Outages.staleApply: Changed meanwhile (now revision {revision}). Save again to apply your change to this version, or discard it.
Outages.staleClosed: This outage is now {status}, so your change cannot be applied.
Outages.cancelledOutages: {count, plural, one {# cancelled entry} other {# cancelled entries}}

CollectionSchedule.enterAValidTimeInEveryRow: Enter a valid time in every row.
CollectionSchedule.eachCollectionTimeMustBeUnique: Each collection time must be unique.
CollectionSchedule.addAtLeastOneCollectionTime: Add at least one collection time.
CollectionSchedule.chooseTimes: Choose forecast collection times in plant time.
CollectionSchedule.dailyHistory: Daily history: {time}. Pausing also stops history collection.
CollectionSchedule.historyHelp: Historical estimate retries preserve requests for scheduled forecasts. Validation and retries can use additional requests. Email reminders do not request provider data. Historical estimates are modeled; EPİAŞ reported production and settlement injection are separate records.

RecycleBin.deletionHelp: Collection will stop. You can restore this plant and its saved data for 30 days. After that, they are permanently deleted.
RecycleBin.retentionHelp: Deleted plants and their data are kept for 30 days.

blockers.location_already_exists: Another plant now uses this location. Move or delete that plant first.

WorkspaceMembers.title: Members
WorkspaceMembers.removeHelp: They will lose access to this workspace. Their account and other workspaces will stay available.
WorkspaceMembers.deliveryUncertain: Email delivery could not be confirmed.
WorkspaceMembers.deliveryFailed: The invitation email was not sent. Send it again.
WorkspaceMembers.reminderLimitWarning: {count, plural, one {# plant includes} other {# plants include}} the workspace members in its email reminders and already reaches the recipient limit. A new member will pause those reminders until the list is shortened.
WorkspaceMembers.resendFailed: The invitation was not sent again
WorkspaceMembers.resent: A new invitation link is being sent to {email}.
WorkspaceMembers.invitationUnavailable: This invitation link can no longer be used. Ask the workspace administrator to send it again.
WorkspaceMembers.signInToJoin: Sign in or create an account with {email} to accept it.

ChangeRequests.providerHourIncomplete: This correction replaces only part of {start} – {end}. The remaining portion will be missing; the hourly source energy is not divided.
ChangeRequests.submitted: Sent for approval. Live data stays unchanged until a workspace administrator approves it.
ChangeRequests.approvalHelp: A workspace administrator reviews this submission before it changes live data.
ChangeRequests.conflict: This submission cannot currently be applied. Refresh and review the conflict.
ChangeRequests.contextChanged: The current data changed. Refresh and review it again before approving.
ChangeRequests.openImpact: Approving this ongoing outage immediately affects live forecasts and reminder emails.
ChangeRequests.title: Title
ChangeRequests.pendingContext: Your pending submissions: {count}. Track them in Inbox.
ChangeRequests.withdrawHelp: To revise a submission, withdraw it and send a new one.
ChangeRequests.draftDayLocked: Send or discard this request before choosing another day.
ChangeRequests.stagedChanged: This interval changed after you added it. Edit or remove it.
ChangeRequests.waitingForApprovalOf: Waiting for approval: view the request for {subject}
